motivation: After reviewing all36 regression frames, the adapted detector false positives mostly resemble bench players. This is an explicitly post-regression follow-up, not a fresh test.
detector: Frozen transformer-lr1e5 epoch2 and validation-selected confidence0.5; no new weight training or confidence retuning.
surface_model: Original pretrained SAM3 segmentation checkpoint, same pinned revision; no human rink polygon.
filter: Union predicted surface masks above mask confidence. Resize nearest-neighbor to252x252; dilate by the specified image-height fraction. Keep player if its bbox bottom-center at2% above bottom is inside the mask. If undilated mask covers <5% or >98% of image, fall back to no filter.
selection: Compare18 filters and unchanged fine-tune on the same23 validation frames. Choose highest F1, then precision, preferring unchanged detector on a tie. Only run selected filter on reused36 regression frames if it improves validation F1.
limits: Post-test hypothesis with validation-based setting selection; not independent accuracy. A surface mask is not homography, metric rink calibration, or visibility proof.
